faq.q: Can you buy the UBTECH Walker S2?
faq.a: Only through UBTECH sales or a reseller quote. UBTECH does not publish a price and asks buyers to use its contact form.

faq.q: How much does the Walker S2 cost?
faq.a: UBTECH has not published a price. RobotShop lists it at $246,600. UBTECH says Walker-series orders since early 2025 exceed 800 million yuan, including a 250 million yuan order in September 2025, but it did not give unit counts or unit prices.

faq.q: Is the Walker S2 in production?
faq.a: UBTECH says Walker S2 is in mass production and delivery, with targets of 500 units delivered in 2025, 5,000 units of annual capacity in 2026 and 10,000 in 2027.

notes: No official price. Third-party sites quote figures from $68,000 to $300,000 without sources; they are not included. Contract values are for orders of many units and cannot be turned into a unit price.
